newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end higher, but off peaks.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end higher, but off peaks.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended the day higher on Thursday, but off peaks, as bonds eased and volatility remained high, dealers said.
"The market remains very volatile and the most immediate reference is the expiry of the futures," a dealer said.
* The General Index closed up 4.72 points, or 0.82 percent, at 582.52. The IBEX-35 index rose 55.07 points, or 0.83 percent, to 6,674.77.
* BBV rose 200 pesetas, or 1.79 percent, to 11,360, after announced net attributable rose 27.5 pct in first five months.
* Other banks rose as well, continuing the sector's strong run, with Argentaria and BCH each rising one percent or more.
* Other blue chips also led the pace, with Gas Natural ending up 1.91 percent and Fecsa climbing 3.38 percent.
